verdict.rationale: Elicit documents a public programmatic API (v2, base URL https://elicit.com/api/v2) with a full OpenAPI 3.1 spec of 46 paths covering Search, Reports, Systematic Reviews and Research Agent. It also has a vendor-hosted Scalar reference, API key management, and an MCP server that exposes all API functionality. The 404 probes on support.elicit.com do not contradict this, because the spec lives at docs.elicit.com. API access requires a Pro plan or above. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the product via the API, a published API changelog and v1 deprecation policy

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: The Elicit API lets you access Elicit's research capabilities programmatically: search 138 million+ academic papers and generate automated research reports from your own code, scripts, and workflows.
Systematic Review: run a full review end to end, with control over search strategy, screening criteria, extraction parameters, and reporting.

Elicit serves a full OpenAPI 3.1.0 document (info title "Elicit API", version 2.0.0; 46 paths across Search, Sessions, Reports, Systematic Reviews, Research Agent and more; server https://elicit.com/api/v2)
Elicit vendor-hosts a Scalar API reference ("Elicit API Reference — Complete API reference for the Elicit research automation platform") embedding the spec.
